chapters.title: Six panels. Where do I start?
chapters.answer: Open A, then F, to compare two views of the same cells.

chapters.title: PCA again. What does it mean here?
chapters.answer: Select the acronym to see its full name and where the authors define it on page 7.

chapters.title: Where did the authors actually say that?
chapters.answer: Open the caption in the PDF. The sentence is highlighted on page 10.

chapters.title: Do I have to explain the whole figure to ask one question?
chapters.answer: Ask how long sampling lasted. The source guide finds the answer in the caption on page 10.

chapters.title: Which page did this slide come from?
chapters.answer: Add the panel and a speaking note. Open the slide to see the figure and page together.
